Gideon's final seat count for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update was **280 seats**.

He first posted 300 at 09:14, then corrected it to 280 at 09:19. He said the 300 came from a combined staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth also referred to 280 in the thread.
